comment.fi:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1">
                            <title>Muuta</title>
                            <remarkFreeText>
                                <translation>Tarkistus 10 mitätöitiin ja se korvattiin tarkistuksella 25.</translation>
                            </remarkFreeText>
                        </remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 10 foi anulada e substituída pela alteração 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 10 is geannuleerd en vervangen door amendement 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 10 ha sido anulada y sustituida por la enmienda 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Rinneadh Leasú 10 a chealú agus cuireadh Leasú 25 ina ionad.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hu: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Egyéb</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A 10. módosítást törölték, és helyébe a 25. módosítás lépett.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 10.a bija atcelts un aizstāts ar grozījumu Nr. 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Разни</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Изменение 10 беше анулирано и заменено от изменение 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 10 a je bil razveljavljen. Nadomestil ga je predlog spremembe 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 10 a été annulé et remplacé par l'amendement 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 10 var blevet annulleret og erstattet med ændringsforslag 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 10 a fost anulat și înlocuit cu amendamentul 25</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1">
                            <title>Varie</title>
                            <remarkFreeText>
                                <translation>L'emendamento 10 è stato cancellato e sostituito dall'emendamento 25.</translation>
                            </remarkFreeText>
                        </remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>AM 10 had been cancelled and replaced by AM 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Övriga frågor</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 10 återkallades och ersattes med ändringsförslag 25</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Η τροπολογία 10 ακυρώθηκε και αντικαταστάθηκε από την τροπολογία 25.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
